annotation_origin: First-pass agent annotations authored from existing source text before prediction runs; all 40 snippets and span lists subsequently checked by the root agent. Not human gold and not independent financial-accuracy labels.

review_notes: Root inspected all 40 exact snippets and entity lists; clear tags accepted under documented named-business-unit and longest-non-nested policy.
European Union adjudicated as LOCATION for this explicit jurisdictional/geographic context; this is not a universal political-union taxonomy claim.
The whole Travelers near-duplicate document cluster was moved to test before inference so all four issuers have test examples.
This is agent-authored, agent-reviewed reference annotation, not human gold or independent professional validation.

source_scope: Existing local corpus only. This bounded reference sample is separate from the required five-model inference over all corpus blocks.
coordinate_system: Python Unicode code-point offsets; half-open [start,end), relative to exact snippet text. Source slice offsets use the same coordinate system in the original corpus block.

annotation_policy.entity_scope: Explicit person names, named legal organizations/regulators/courts and identifiable named corporate units/brands; explicit countries, cities, states, geopolitical abbreviations and named geographic regions.
annotation_policy.boundary_rule: Longest non-overlapping named span; retain legal suffixes and internal punctuation, exclude external honorifics, ages, possessive suffixes and role titles. Parenthesized acronym/alias is a separate occurrence. No nested labels.
annotation_policy.org_loc_rule: A location inside a complete organization name is not separately labeled. A regulator, court or named corporate unit is ORGANIZATION, not a place. Standalone geopolitical names/abbreviations are LOCATION. Root adjudicated European Union as LOCATION in the explicit geographic/jurisdictional context of the selected sentence; not a universal taxonomy claim.
annotation_policy.excluded: Dates, numbers, percentages, laws/forms/frameworks, generic organizational nouns/coreferences, security tickers, street addresses/postal codes, adjectival nationality terms and the complement non-U.S. are outside this three-type sample. Explicit U.S. in geopolitical context is LOCATION; U.S. inside named metrics/accounting frameworks is excluded.
annotation_policy.certainty: Only clear spans are scored. All initial uncertainty has been adjudicated by root before inference; the context-specific EU decision is recorded on that span. Any later uncertainty must be reported explicitly and not silently counted as false positives.
annotation_policy.completeness: Agent attempted exhaustive common-type annotations inside each bounded snippet under this policy; second review is required. Labels are not exhaustive for entire source blocks or whole reports.

selection.method: Fixed agent-curated source-block manifest: one bounded coverage snippet per document, plus ten person-focused supplements. No model predictions, scores or outputs were used.
biases: Purposeful entity-bearing selection; not a random or representative corpus sample.
One deliberate zero-entity snippet, sparse negatives, unequal label/issuer frequencies.
Officer lists, legal certification and table fragments are included; PDF text extraction artifacts remain where part of the exact slice.
The small sample cannot support broad accuracy claims for all 30 reports.

Development contains only BAC/JPM references after the whole Travelers cluster was moved to test. Test includes all four issuers, with unequal label frequencies. No per-issuer broad accuracy claim follows.

split_policy.unit: source document, with connected groups for near-duplicate reference excerpts
split_policy.near_duplicate_method: Casefold and replace numeric sequences with #; join documents if any chosen excerpt pair has difflib.SequenceMatcher ratio >=0.82. Similar entity names alone do not define duplication.
split_policy.assignment: Initial deterministic cluster ordering used SHA-256 of ner-reference-v1:<lexical first document>. Before inference, root moved the complete Travelers near-duplicate document cluster from development to test so all four issuers occur in test; no cluster or source document is split.
split_policy.warning: Development/test sets are document-separated with chosen-reference near-duplicates grouped, not proven free of all full-corpus textual overlap. Labels and entity names may recur in genuinely different contexts. Freeze scoring/threshold choices before using the test subset.
split_policy.coverage_limit: Development contains BAC and JPM only; test includes BAC, JPM, TRV and CB. Counts are small and uneven; this is not a representative per-issuer balanced held-out benchmark.

root_override.reason: Include all four issuers in held-out sample while preserving near-duplicate grouping.

split_policy.threshold_policy: Model thresholds/settings must be declared before test inference. This small development sample is not used to optimize against test results.

retrieval_judgments.scope: Only bounded reference snippet relevance is reviewed provisionally; full-corpus unjudged hits are not negative.
retrieval_judgments.metrics: For full-corpus ranking report known-positive recall@k / reciprocal rank with incomplete-judgment caveat. Exact precision can only be evaluated in a completely judged candidate pool under this sample criterion.
retrieval_judgments.query_split_note: Nine queries have known test positives. The Japan/Australia query is development-only. For held-out metrics use only relevant test passage/block IDs and keep document folds separate. Do not treat development positives or other unjudged full-corpus hits as negatives.

reporting_policy.primary_ner_metrics: Exact-span-and-type precision/recall/F1 on the 32 test snippets only, with label counts and agent-reviewed reference provenance.
reporting_policy.all_reference_coverage: Report all 40 reference predictions and annotation coverage separately; do not call all-fold scores held-out or full-corpus accuracy.
reporting_policy.full_corpus: Running predictions over every corpus block measures processing coverage, not full-corpus extraction accuracy.
reporting_policy.retrieval: Known-positive recall/MRR use incomplete judgments and test references only; unjudged results are not negatives.
